step.cmd: In FTS, if there is no registration number, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Select the Disqualifications/Disentitlements (M161) transaction and impose the 14 - Voiding benefit period disentitlement ( D14 ) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.
Start date: Enter the Monday of the BPC week from the new claim.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Message: Select 4 - An overpayment resulted due to an indefinite disentitlement .
Complete: Select D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the applicable registration number.

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Remarks line 1: Type “WS BPC+103 — Cancel BPC [BPC of the claim being cancelled]. Renew BPC [BPC of the previous claim].”
Remarks line 2: Type “Process as BT [BT requested on the EI application] in MPS. Current LRW [TLRW]. Add MA14.”
Remarks line 3: Enter the WS start and end dates displayed on the last Project Data - Worksharing (M171) transaction in FTS and CR details, and type “Recoup OP from BPC [BPC of the cancelled claim].
Remarks line 4: Enter the WS agreement number, normal weekly hours (NWH) and NO-CR coding, if necessary.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select A - Non-fraud - Earnings and employment .
Message: Select 55 - Change to Worksharing/Job Creation .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
